title: Coal India MT 2026 - 660 Management Trainee Vacancies for B.Tech Candidates, Apply by June 11
author: Ash K.
summary: Coal India Limited (CIL) released MT Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 03/2026) for 660 Management Trainee vacancies in E1 Grade. Apply online at coalindia.in from May 12 to June 11, 2026. Disciplines: Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, System, E&T, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Hindi, Company Secretary. Age: up to 30 years. Selection via CBT. Starting salary: ₹50,000+/month in E1 grade.
body: Coal India Limited (CIL), India's largest coal-producing PSU and one of the world's biggest mining companies, has released the CIL Management Trainee (MT) Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. 03/2026) for 660 vacancies in E1 Grade. Online applications are open at coalindia.in until June 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM. This is one of the most significant PSU engineering recruitment drives of 2026.

DetailInformation
Advertisement No.03/2026 (dated May 5, 2026)
Total Vacancies660 (647 fresh + 13 backlog)
Apply Start DateMay 12, 2026
Last Date to ApplyJune 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM
Apply Websitecoalindia.in (Career with CIL section)
GradeE1 Grade (Management Trainee)
Age Limit (General/EWS)Up to 30 years
Age RelaxationSC/ST: 5 years | OBC-NCL: 3 years | PwD: 10 years
Selection ProcessComputer Based Test (CBT) → Document Verification
Starting Salary (E1 Grade)₹50,000–₹1,60,000/month + IDA + perks
PwD Posts64 posts reserved (horizontal basis)

DisciplineQualification Required
Civil EngineeringB.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (min 60% for General/EWS/OBC)
Electrical EngineeringB.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics
Mechanical EngineeringB.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
System (IT/CS)B.E./B.Tech in IT, Computer Science, or MCA
Electronics & Telecom (E&T)B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / E&T / ECE
GeologyM.Sc in Geology / Applied Geology (min 60%)
Industrial EngineeringB.E./B.Tech in Industrial/Production Engineering
Rajbhasha (Hindi)MA in Hindi with English at degree level (or vice versa)
Company SecretaryACS/FCS from ICSI + graduation degree

Minimum marks requirement: General, EWS, and OBC candidates must have scored a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying degree. SC, ST, and PwD candidates require 50% minimum. Candidates in their final semester/year of the qualifying degree can also apply but must complete the degree by the time of joining.

Selection process - CBT pattern: The selection is entirely based on a Computer Based Test (CBT). No interview is conducted. The CBT has questions from the relevant engineering/professional discipline, General Knowledge, and Reasoning. Total marks and duration vary by discipline - refer to the official notification PDF for the complete pattern. Final merit list is prepared strictly based on CBT marks. There is no Group Discussion or interview round.

Why CIL MT is a great opportunity: E1 Grade is an executive-level position in a Navratna PSU. The pay of ₹50,000–₹1,60,000/month in E1 Grade is under the IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) pay scale, which also includes performance-related pay, medical benefits, housing allowance, and Coal India's own perks like subsidised canteen and Leave Travel Concession (LTC). Career progression goes from E1 to E2, E3 and beyond with experience. See our SIP Calculator to plan your savings once you join, or Sarkari vs Private Job comparison for more context.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for Coal India Management Trainee 2026 is June 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Apply online at coalindia.in under the 'Career with CIL' section.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: Coal India MT 2026 has 660 vacancies (647 fresh + 13 backlog) in E1 Grade across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, System, E&T, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Rajbhasha (Hindi), and Company Secretary disciplines.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in the relevant engineering discipline (or M.Sc for Geology, ACS/FCS for Company Secretary, MA for Rajbhasha) with minimum 60% marks for General/EWS/OBC category and 50% for SC/ST/PwD. Age limit is up to 30 years for General/EWS candidates.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: Selection is entirely based on a Computer Based Test (CBT). There is no interview or Group Discussion. Final merit list is prepared strictly on CBT marks followed by document verification.

faqs.question: What is the salary for Coal India MT E1 Grade?
faqs.answer: Coal India Management Trainee E1 Grade pay scale is ₹50,000–₹1,60,000/month under IDA scale. Additionally, candidates receive Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA), performance-related pay, medical benefits, housing allowance, and Leave Travel Concession.

faqs.question: Can final year B.Tech students apply for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates appearing in the final semester/year of their qualifying degree can apply for Coal India MT 2026 provisionally. However, they must complete the degree and provide the final marksheet at the time of joining.
